name: Fiendish Reflection
description: Reflections viewed in the water here appear monstrous and fiendish.
disable: DC 20 Religion check to exorcise the haunt, or DC 23 Intimidation check to turn the fear back on the haunt and overwhelm it
reset: The haunt resets immediately and can trigger again the next round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Frightening Visage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature looks at the water

Effect The creature sees its reflection on the water's surface distort into a fiendish version of themselves; they must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or become Frightened 2 (and Fleeing for as long as they remain frightened on a critical failure).
